lines.text: No, wait. If the weight goes down the second pier and... oh. You are looking. Hello.
That is nothing. A doodle. Please do not look at the doodle.
It is an arch. A big arch.
...It is the arch. The Arch. Do you like it?

choice.text: It is beautiful. People will remember it.
Show me where the weight goes. I want to understand it.

lines.text: Really? Nobody says that. Master Voll just says 'load path' and walks away.
Oh no. Oh yes. Here. The weight goes here, then here, then... there is a second path. I forgot the second path.
